verdict.rationale: Unleash is a feature-flag management platform, not an agent or assistant that consumes tools, so acting as an MCP client is outside its product role. Its documented MCP integration is an MCP server that lets external coding assistants manage flags. That server role is a different story and does not make this client axis applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
